verdict.rationale: The axis applies because a tax-filing portal could reasonably support batch operations. The only relevant evidence is a single line saying invoices can be uploaded in bulk through the GST Offline Tool for return filing, plus a developer API portal whose capabilities are not described. That is thin, glancing support. Missing for 10: documented bulk operations beyond invoice upload, evidence of API-driven batch actions across many items (e.g., bulk filings or updates), any agent- or automation-oriented bulk workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
